result.note: Tests the Fleet Support Ship programme: numbers, builders, role, launch site, delivery timeline and the Kattupalli yard location.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Fleet Support Ships being built for the Indian Navy, the first of which was due to be launched in October 2026:
items: Five such ships are being built, each displacing 43,500 tonnes.
Hindustan Shipyard Limited leads the programme, with Larsen & Toubro contracted for part-construction of two ships.
The ships will carry fuel, water, ammunition and stores to supply warships at sea.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct: five 43,500-tonne ships, led by Hindustan Shipyard with L&T building parts of two, will replenish warships with fuel, water, ammunition and stores. This allows longer deployments between port visits, helping the Navy sustain several missions at once.
questions.source: The ships will carry fuel, water, ammunition, and stores.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the Indian Navy's Fleet Support Ship programme as of October 2026:
items: The first ship was due to be launched at Hindustan Shipyard Limited in Visakhapatnam on 6 October 2026.
Deliveries of the ships are scheduled to begin in mid-2026.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong: deliveries are scheduled to begin in mid-2027, and dates for trials and operational service had not been announced. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh was also to inaugurate an upgraded slipway and a 300-tonne crane at the yard.
questions.source: The first of five Fleet Support Ships being built for the Indian Navy is due to launch today, 6 October, at Hindustan Shipyard Limited in Visakhapatnam.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, Larsen & Toubro was carrying out part-construction of two Indian Navy Fleet Support Ships at Kattupalli. Kattupalli is located near which city?
questions.explain: L&T's share of the work is at Kattupalli, near Chennai, while Hindustan Shipyard in Visakhapatnam leads the programme. Concurrent construction at the two yards is intended to meet delivery timelines.
questions.source: Hindustan Shipyard leads the programme, with Larsen & Toubro contracted for part-construction of two ships at Kattupalli, near Chennai.
